spec.assertion: Structural: trigger hitCount{count:120, no countInFb}, target allies (excludeSelf false), shield{maxHpPct:11.8, durationSec:5}, exactly one shield channel. Behavioural (inert-stat marker appended to the COMMITTED block): fires >=3× in 180 s, targets == full roster, and halving the threshold to 60 must ~double the fires (ratio 1.7-2.3). RED under lastBullet/interval/hitCount:60 (patch is a no-op → ratio 1.0) and under a self-only target (1 target slug).

Encoding pinned structurally; magnitude unobservable (no HP pool, no shield event kind) → it.skip. Inertness: stripping the shield leaves all four slugs byte-identical, proving no accidental damage coupling and no hidden shield-consumer.

spec.kitLine: After FB ends: all allies HoT 5s
spec.assertion: Structural: trigger fullBurstEnd, no everyN, target allies incl. self, heal{ticks:5, intervalSec:1}. Behavioural: marker activations == fullBurstEnd count, and each activation's nearest preceding FB boundary in the event stream is 'fullBurstEnd'. RED under a fullBurstEnter keying (identical per-fight COUNT, so order is the only discriminator) and under ticks omitted (default 1).

Tandem: stripping every heal must lower total buffApply traffic (crown is the control comp's on-recovery consumer) and cannot raise team damage; collapsing 5+8 ticks to 1 must also lose recovery events. RED under 'heals are defensive, skip them' (failure-mode 4) and under a single-instant-heal encoding. Amount (% of Max HP) is unrepresentable → it.skip.

Structural: trigger fullBurstEnd, target self, burstCdr{seconds:40.76, no oncePerBattle}, gate teamHas.slugs contains 'noir' (no squad axis in the data; teamHas.slugs is the sanctioned encoding). Behavioural pair: with no squad-mate in the comp, removing the CDR changes neither blanc's cast count nor any total (gate holds); deleting the gate must RAISE her cast count (effect is live, so the gate is non-vacuous). An ungated encoding fails both directions; target allies would slash the whole team's cooldowns.
Structural: target allies incl. self, heal{ticks:8, intervalSec:1}. Behavioural coverage via the shared heal-strip / one-tick counterfactuals. RED under ticks:1 or an excludeSelf target.

Structural: target alliesLowestHp{count:1, excludeSelf:true}, buff{stat:'maxHpPct', value:31.68, durationSec:10}. Behavioural: exactly one maxHpPct row per cast, never targeting blanc, and NO maxHpFlat row anywhere — which rules out a casterMaxHpPct encoding (the engine flat-resolves that stat). Inertness: removing the grant leaves all totals byte-identical (e3 rule: ally-granted Max HP never feeds atkOfMaxHpPct).
Asserted present in unmodeled.burst (case-insensitive 'indomitab') — the no-silent-drops pin — plus an it.skip recording that there is no defensive-immunity primitive in v1.

Structural: target enemy, buff damageTakenPct 39.26, durationSec 10. Behavioural: every such buffApply has casterIdx === null AND targetIdx === null (boss-held, not ally-scoped); removing it LOWERS team total; stretching 10 s → 120 s RAISES team total, so the window is load-bearing. RED under a permanent/no-durationSec encoding (the stretch patch becomes a no-op) and under an allies/self mis-scope (indices non-null).

No flatDamage/dot/storedHit/stackedNuke/weaponSwap effect in any slot; no buff on any of 21 offensive or weapon-state stats (atkPct, crit*, attackDamagePct, reloadSpeedPct, fireRatePct, maxAmmo*, hitRatePct, …); no instantReload/consumeAmmo/unlimitedAmmo/fillGauge/gainPierce/stun; hasPierce false; all three slots populated. RED if calibration pressure ever fudged a damage or shot-economy line into a Defender whose kit has none.

fixtures: controlComp('blanc', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / blanc / helm B3, boss Fire, deterministic (no seed), 11 hoisted runs. helm is kept IN because both skill2 lines are Full-Burst-END keyed and a chain without a B3 completes zero Full Bursts. crown is load-bearing twice: she is the comp's on-recovery consumer (the ONLY damage-visible channel blanc's heal lines have — blanc grants no ATK/crit anywhere, so heal-strip inertness would otherwise be untestable), and she is a SECOND Burst II, so blanc contends for stage 2 — hence an explicit non-vacuity `it` asserting blanc casts at least once (read off the boss-held 39.26% debuff). If that guard fails, the correct conclusion is 'the control comp starves a Burst II carry, need a sole-B2 fixture', not 'the burst slot is wrong'. Two techniques carry the file: (1) STRUCTURAL reads of the committed override obtained in-memory via withPatchedOverride(slug, () => {}) (no fs access needed), and (2) INSTRUMENTATION — a marker buff on the engine-inert stat partsDamagePct appended to a COMMITTED block, leaving its trigger/target/gates intact, so the marker's buffApply stream reports the committed trigger's real cadence and target set for effects (shield, heal) that emit no observable event kind. A totals-identity check (INSTR.t === BASE.t) proves the marker is damage-neutral.
gaps: shield magnitude 11.8% of caster Max HP — no HP pool, no shield-break, and onEvent surfaces no shield event kind; only a shield-consumer kit (naga-style `shielded` trigger) could read it and the control comp has none
heal magnitudes 3.68% / 3.84% of caster Max HP — the `heal` effect has no amount field at all (recovery events carry no HP), so the percentages are unrepresentable in v1 and belong in `unmodeled`
Gain Indomitability — no defensive-immunity primitive; auditable only as unmodeled text
hitCount counting ROUNDS vs trigger pulls is indistinguishable for blanc (hitsPerShot 1), so the 120 threshold cannot be attributed to either reading from this unit alone
'still on the battlefield' half of the same-squad clause — nobody dies in v1, so only the squad-MEMBERSHIP half is gateable
'lowest remaining HP' ally selection — no HP pool, so the engine's leftmost stand-in cannot be validated against real HP ranking (damage-neutral because the grant is offensively inert)
